findings.finding: No registered offering can price in the window: the $300m S-3 filed 2026-08-28 (baby-shelf limited, no ATM agent named) has no EFFECT notice on EDGAR, and the company has never done a registered follow-on since the August 2025 IPO, so the ATM or shelf takedown that is the commonest second leg for a sub-$100m faller is not available tonight.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Lands inside the window as an absence that is checkable at the open: a takedown needs an effective registration, and EDGAR's submission index shows no EFFECT after 2025-08-20, so nothing can be priced under the S-3 between the 09-22 close and the 09-23 close unless the SEC declares it effective and a 424B5 follows within the same session.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior registered offering to compare: the only equity raise since the IPO was the unregistered Reg S sale of 32M shares at $0.25, closed 2026-06-04 and 8-K'd 2026-06-08. The baseline's own falls (2025-08-22 IPO-week -58%, 2026-08-24/25) do not coincide with a financing.
findings.why_not_priced: The cross-section base rate this name is ranked against bakes in the names that have a live ATM and draw it overnight; this one cannot draw on a registered shelf tonight. If the tape had priced a dilution leg, the fall would have come with an offering-shaped signature (a gap on a filing and heavy volume); instead it is an intraday unwind on 1.5x volume.
findings.independence: The S-3 itself states that no securities have been sold under General Instruction I.B.6 in the prior 12 months and names no sales agent: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2053641/000110465926103393/tm2623148d1_s3.htm . The browse-edgar atom feed shows nothing filed after 2026-09-08: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0002053641&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=20&output=atom

outside_window.finding: 32,000,000 Class A shares (72% of 44.55M outstanding) sold 2026-06-04 at $0.25 to eight non-US investors under Reg S are restricted securities; the Rule 144 six-month holding period for a reporting issuer ends about 2026-12-04, when holders sitting on a ~7x gain can resell in the US. This is a large dated supply release, and it is outside the window.
If the S-3 is declared effective, a baby-shelf takedown (capped at one-third of public float in 12 months) becomes possible; no EFFECT notice and no acceleration request are visible yet.

Fiscal Q3 (quarter ended 2026-08-31) 10-Q and results; the prior year's Q3 filing came 2025-10-14. Single-customer (FedEx) revenue and a widening loss on the AI-platform spend ($3.3m Leyan development agreement).
